card.name: Skin-related words and word starts
card.fires_on: Fires on a word or word start where skin terms such as dermal, cutaneous or subcutaneous are likely to come next, for example 'sub' before 'cutaneous' or 'ear' before tumors. It also fires on sentence-opening 'Sub' or 'Trans' that begins a longer word.

modes.label: Skin-route word starts
modes.description: The start 'sub' of subcutaneous or subdermal, in injection and skin-effect text.
modes.example: Administer IMLYGIC by injection into cutaneous,<< sub>>cutaneous, and/or nodal lesions

modes.label: Sentence-opening word starts
modes.description: A capitalized 'Sub' or 'Trans' opening a sentence and beginning a longer word.
modes.example: << Sub>>sequent ECGs showed normal sinus rhythm

modes.label: Body-part or linking words
modes.description: Small words such as 'ear', 'of' or 'in' just before an organ or skin-related term.

card.writes: It pushes toward word pieces like 'der', 'Derm', 'Cut' and 'ul', which begin skin-related words.
card.plain: It lights up on word starts such as 'sub' where a skin word like subcutaneous or dermal is expected next.
